verdict.rationale: Unstructured documents an official Python SDK that calls its API to partition, enrich, chunk and embed files, and that also creates, updates, runs and deletes workflows. The llms.txt probe confirms SDK examples use a Transform SDK package. missing for 10: evidence of official SDKs in languages beyond Python, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use, a published OpenAPI spec for generated clients (probe paths 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The Unstructured Python SDK enables you to call the Unstructured API with standard Python code to partition, enrich, chunk, and embed your files.
You can call the Unstructured API with the Unstructured Python SDK and with standard REST clients (such as cURL and Postman).
Build and manage Unstructured workflows with the Python SDK or REST endpoints.
SDK examples use the Transform SDK package.
